text.arabic_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

words.gloss_range: opening connective of sequential consequence, binding the ayah to the warning scene before it and launching the compressed chain
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) opens the ayah as a consequence marker, so the denial is heard as the immediate answer to the warning in 91:13 rather than as an isolated report. The same small connective also starts the ayah's four-link run: denial, hamstringing, punishment, and final leveling arrive with little narrative space between them. Its first position matters because it makes sequence itself the first signal, turning the protected speech of 91:13 into the beginning of a causal cascade.

topics.headline: opening consequence from the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as the direct sequel to the warning in 91:13, not as a fresh narrative start.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as sequential consequence linking to the prior narrative, and the clause evidence places it before the first denial clause.

topics.headline: first link in the four-connective cascade
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is structured as a rapid chain whose repeated connective moves from human crime to divine consequence.
topics.reason: The word table and clause sequence show four connective-prefixed clauses, with this first particle establishing the repeated pattern.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect transitive denial or falsification by a plural subject, with a masculine singular object suffix whose referent should remain open between the messenger and the warning proposition
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes lying and declaring another false; local Form II selects active transitive rejection rather than merely telling a lie
words.prose: {{ar:كَذَّبُوهُ}} ({{tr:kadhdhabūhu}}) is the first full action after the opening connective, and it reports denial as a completed collective act. Form II makes the action transitive: the group does not merely lie; they treat a truth-claim as false. The object suffix keeps the prior scene active, but attachment evidence leaves its referent open between the messenger in 91:13 and the warning proposition, so the prose should preserve that ambiguity rather than force only one object. The root also returns from 91:11, where Thamud's denial was summarized, and here that summary becomes a concrete act inside the final chain. Its messenger-rejection pattern also belongs with wider denial scenes (26:141; 54:9), while the local suffix and Thamud setting keep those parallels from taking over the parse.

topics.headline: completed communal denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the crime begins as a decisive group response before the physical attack appears.
topics.reason: The aligned verb is perfect 3mp with an implicit plural subject, and the clause sequence places it before the hamstringing verb.

topics.headline: Form II makes denial a hostile transitive act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not simple lying but an act of declaring the received warning false.
topics.reason: QAC tags the verb as Form II with an object suffix, and the lexical evidence supports the transitive denial branch.

topics.headline: the object suffix carries the prior scene but stays open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small suffix pulls 91:13 into the word while keeping both personal messenger-denial and warning-denial in play.
topics.reason: Some CRITICAL rows force the messenger as referent, but attachment support marks the masculine singular object as ambiguous between the messenger and the warning proposition, so the topic survives only with that limit.

topics.headline: earlier corporate denial becomes specific action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial root from 91:11 returns here as the enacted response that drives the ending.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the concrete same-surah echo to 91:11, and the local verb supplies the specific final-act form of that denial.

topics.headline: messenger-rejection motif without importing other scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this denial belongs to a wider Quranic messenger-rejection pattern while the local suffix and Thamud scene still control the reading.
topics.reason: The broader pattern is valid as a motif, but it should not override the local ambiguity of the object suffix or import full details from 26:141 and 54:9.

words.gloss_range: immediate sequential connective that moves from denial into bodily violation
words.prose: The second {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks escalation. It joins the denial verb to the hamstringing verb as successive human acts, so verbal rejection is not left as an inner attitude; it moves at once into physical violation of the protected she-camel. Because the same clipped connective repeats, the ayah keeps its staccato pace while changing the action it introduces.

topics.headline: denial escalates into bodily violation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tight move from rejecting the warning to attacking the sign it protected.
topics.reason: QAC and clause evidence mark this particle as immediate sequence between the denial clause and the hamstringing clause.

topics.headline: same small form restarts the chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated short onset makes the next act feel abrupt rather than leisurely narrated.
topics.reason: The identical connective form recurs before a new perfect verb, matching the ayah's rapid clause pattern.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural action against a feminine object, locally the she-camel from 91:13; hamstringing, disabling, and fatal wounding are active together
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes hamstringing, disabling, fatal wounding, and barrenness or severed continuity; local verb selects bodily disabling of the she-camel, with continuity-loss as image pressure
words.prose: {{ar:عَقَرُوهَا}} ({{tr:ʿaqarūhā}}) compresses plural agents and the feminine object into one completed verb. The feminine suffix is strongly anchored to the she-camel of 91:13, so the act is not generic violence but the attack on the very protected sign. The root field keeps hamstringing, disabling, and fatal wounding together: they kill by crippling, cutting off the animal's mobility and the provision-bound continuity protected by the warning. Because this rare root marks the Thamud she-camel motif elsewhere (7:77; 11:65; 26:157; 54:29), the word carries that whole violation scene into the ayah while remaining a concrete Form I bodily act.

topics.headline: plural completed attack on a living patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a collective completed deed directed against a living body, not only a rule violation.
topics.reason: The local verb is a perfect 3mp Form I verb with a feminine object suffix, and attachment evidence treats that suffix as the direct object.

topics.headline: feminine suffix keeps the she-camel present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 91:14 does not rename the she-camel because the suffix carries her forward from 91:13.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence strongly licenses the feminine object suffix as resuming the she-camel from the preceding quote.

topics.headline: hamstringing kills by disabling and cutting continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act destroys function and protected provision, not only life in a generic sense.
topics.reason: The local sense is concrete hamstringing or fatal disabling; barrenness and severed-continuity evidence can remain as image pressure but does not replace the bodily act.

topics.headline: rare she-camel verb marks the Thamud motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this uncommon verb is a motif marker for the she-camel violation across the Thamud passages.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete parallels in 7:77, 11:65, 26:157, and 54:29, and the local object is the same she-camel motif.

topics.headline: protected object becomes violated patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from the protected sign in 91:13 to the wounded grammatical object in 91:14.
topics.reason: The pronoun link and boundary rows converge: the object protected by the warning is the object acted upon by the hamstringing verb.

words.gloss_range: causal consequence connective, pivoting from the two human acts to divine punishment
words.prose: The third {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the pivot of the ayah's chain. After denial and hamstringing, the same connective form now carries causal force: the crushing follows as consequence, not as a merely next event. That sameness of surface with a shift in function lets the ayah turn from human escalation to divine response without slowing the sequence.

topics.headline: same connective pivots into consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exactly where the ayah turns from human crime into divine consequence.
topics.reason: QAC marks this particle as causal consequence, and the attachment support says the punishment is scoped as the result of the hamstringing.

topics.headline: formal repetition with changing force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated particle is not monotonous; its role changes by position across the ayah.
topics.reason: The same surface particle recurs, but the word table distinguishes the third occurrence as causal rather than simple sequence.

words.gloss_range: reduplicated quadriliteral perfect verb of overwhelming crushing or obliteration, governing the target phrase and causal phrase while delaying the explicit subject
words.root_gloss_range: destruction field involving crushing, covering over, toppling, and obliteration; local active surface selects sound-iconic comprehensive crushing by the later-named Lord

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: target complement marking those upon whom the punishment falls
delayed explicit subject naming the punishing agent
causal phrase giving the ground of the punishment

words.prose: {{ar:دَمْدَمَ}} ({{tr:damdama}}) is the punishment verb, and it arrives before the explicit subject is named. Its syntax is not bare catastrophe: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) gives the recipients, {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) resolves the delayed agent, and {{ar:بِذَنۢبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:bi-dhanbihim}}) gives the cause. The reduplicated form makes the destruction feel repeated, grinding, and comprehensive, while the active canonical reading keeps divine agency visible. Variant readings and lexical substitutes narrow the field toward crushing, toppling, and demolition; they support the destruction range without replacing the local active surface. As a Quranic hapax, the word gives this punishment scene its own heavy sound. It also turns the God-attributed sign scene of 91:13 into a God-executed punishment scene in 91:14.

topics.headline: destruction has target, agent, and cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment is syntactically targeted and morally grounded, not an agentless disaster.
topics.reason: The verb instance governs the target phrase with {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) and the causal phrase with {{ar:بـ}} ({{tr:bi}}), with the subject supplied by word 8.

topics.headline: the act lands before the agent is named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause order: crushing is heard first, then the Lord is revealed as its agent.
topics.reason: The verb is 3ms perfect and precedes the explicit nominative subject at word 8.

topics.headline: reduplication carries grinding obliteration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word's internal repetition makes the destruction feel enveloping and crushing, not a single light blow.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a reduplicated quadriliteral perfect verb, and the lexical rows converge on comprehensive crushing and covering-over destruction.

topics.headline: variants confirm destruction but do not govern the parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted and reported variants cluster around destruction while the canonical active wording still foregrounds the later-named Lord as agent.
topics.reason: The passive and lexical variants are useful contrast, but the aligned local surface is active and has an explicit subject in word 8.

topics.headline: unique sound for this punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the punishment is marked by a singular Quranic sound-shape reserved for this scene.
topics.reason: QAC and CRITICAL rows identify the root as a Quranic hapax, while the sound rows explain why that uniqueness is audible as well as lexical.

topics.headline: divine sign becomes divine punishment scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from a God-attributed sign in 91:13 to a God-executed punishment in 91:14.
topics.reason: The local punishment verb opens the divine-response clause after the she-camel violation.

words.gloss_range: prepositional target complement marking the punished group as those upon or against whom the crushing descends

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: delayed explicit subject after the target phrase

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِمْ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) supplies the target of the crushing. The preposition marks the punishment as coming upon or against them, not as a neutral location, and the suffix keeps the recipients identical with the group who denied and hamstrung. Its position before {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) makes the hearer encounter the victims under the action before the agent is named.

topics.headline: punishment descends upon the target group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase marks the community as the target under force, not merely the place where punishment happened.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the phrase as the governed target complement of the destruction verb and translation support warns against flattening it into location.

topics.headline: same group remains under liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pronoun keeps agency and liability attached to the same community without renaming them.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence strongly licenses the masculine plural suffix as resuming the Thamud group targeted by punishment.

topics.headline: target phrase precedes the named subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: the community is placed under the crushing before the Lord is explicitly named.
topics.reason: The local order is verb, target phrase, then explicit subject.

words.gloss_range: definite relational noun by possessive annexation, serving as the delayed subject and naming the punishing agent as their Lord
words.root_gloss_range: lordship range includes ownership, sustaining, managing, governing, and disposing; local use foregrounds relational authority acting in punishment

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: their sin as the causal ground that completes the accountability frame

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbuhum}}) resolves the punishment clause by naming the delayed subject. The agent is not introduced by a detached proper name but by a possessive relation: their Lord. That relation makes the punishment judicially charged, because the one associated with ownership, sustaining, and governance acts against the community bound to Him by the suffix. The same plural suffix pattern will return in {{ar:ذَنۢبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dhanbihim}}), so the clause binds their Lord and their sin into one accountability frame. The title also keeps the punishment inside the surah's wider field of divine building and proportioning (91:5; 91:7), now turned toward judgment rather than formation.

topics.headline: delayed subject names the agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause withholds the agent until after the crushing and its target have landed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies word 8 as the explicit subject of the destruction verb after the target phrase.

topics.headline: the punisher is their own Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment comes through a relationship of lordship, ownership, and governance, not from an unnamed external force.
topics.reason: The noun is definite by possessive suffix, and lexical evidence supports ownership, sustaining, managing, and governing within the lordship field.

topics.headline: suffix binds Lord, recipients, and sin
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same community is grammatically tied to the punishment, their Lord, and their sin.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence ties the suffix in word 8 to the same group as word 7, and word 10 repeats the same possessive relation for the sin.

topics.headline: earlier divine ordering shadows the punishing Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord who governs this punishment belongs to the same surah world of divine ordering and proportioning.
topics.reason: The echo to earlier divine creative action in the surah is meaningful, but it remains an inter-ayah resonance rather than a new local lexical sense for the noun.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition attached to the sin noun, giving the reason for the punishment with secondary instrumental pressure only as a qualified nuance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the sin noun governed by the causal preposition

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) attaches the sin phrase to the destruction verb as its cause. The clause has already named the act, target, and agent; this preposition supplies the moral explanation. Because it is proclitic to {{ar:ذَنۢبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dhanbihim}}), cause and offense arrive as one compact phrase. Instrumental pressure may be heard only in a limited way: their sin is the means by which ruin catches them, but the governed role remains causal.

topics.headline: preposition gives the reason for punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destruction is explicitly explained by their offense rather than left as unmotivated force.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment support identify the preposition as causal and attach word 10 as the causal complement of the destruction verb.

topics.headline: instrumental pressure remains secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sin can be felt as the way they bring ruin upon themselves, while grammar keeps cause as the selected role.
topics.reason: The instrumental nuance is semantically plausible, but translation support explicitly warns that the phrase should not be flattened into an instrumental object.

topics.headline: cause is fused to the offense noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the causal explanation is not a separate aside; it is attached directly to the named offense at the clause's close.
topics.reason: The preposition is a proclitic on the sin noun and follows the act-target-agent sequence as the final explanation.

words.gloss_range: singular abstract sin or offense with plural possessive suffix, governed by causal {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and assigning collective responsibility
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes sin, fault, offense, and tail or hinder-part imagery; local noun selects punishable offense while the trailing-consequence image remains as pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: causal preposition governing the sin noun

words.prose: {{ar:ذَنۢبِهِمْ}} ({{tr:dhanbihim}}) names the cause as their own offense. The singular noun with a plural suffix compresses the community's wrongdoing into one collective liability, and the governed case under {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) ties that liability directly to the crushing. The noun names the offense rather than labeling them with an agent noun, so the clause focuses on the punishable ground. The root's tail or hinder-part image can remain as a narrowed pressure: their sin is the trailing consequence of their action catching up with them. Its plural suffix also repeats the clause's liability chain: the same community is under the punishment, related to their Lord, and bound to the offense that explains the judgment. The formula also resonates with other punishment formulas (3:11; 8:52; 40:21), while 91:8's moral vocabulary reaches its narrative realization here.

topics.headline: their singular offense carries collective liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offense is grammatically theirs and unified as the liability of the whole community.
topics.reason: QAC marks a singular abstract noun with a plural possessive suffix, and attachment evidence treats the suffix as referring to the punished group.

topics.headline: sin is the governed causal ground
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar assigns responsibility by making their offense the explicit cause of the punishment.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by causal {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), and the lexical sense supports sin, fault, and punishable offense.

topics.headline: noun names the offense rather than the sinners
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause highlights the offense as the ground of judgment instead of switching to a label for the people.
topics.reason: The local form is an abstract noun, not an agent noun or committing-sin verb.

topics.headline: tail image makes sin trail the deed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the image of offense as what follows behind action and catches up as consequence.
topics.reason: The local noun means sin or offense, while the tail and hinder-part branch can remain as background image-pressure for consequence.

topics.headline: formulaic sin phrase answers the surah's moral frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the causal sin phrase is both a recurring punishment formula and the narrative realization of the moral split introduced in 91:8.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula parallels in 3:11, 8:52, and 40:21, and a same-surah moral echo to 91:8.

topics.headline: plural suffix continues the liability chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated plural suffix tying the recipients, their Lord, and their sin into one relational chain.
topics.reason: The suffix in word 10 resumes the same community as the suffixes in words 7 and 8, and the occurrence rows align the sin phrase with punishment contexts.

words.gloss_range: final resultative connective introducing the completed leveling state

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final leveling verb introduced by the resultative connective

words.prose: The final {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) does not introduce another human crime. It moves from the crushing to the result that seals it, preparing {{ar:سَوَّىٰهَا}} ({{tr:sawwāhā}}) as the terminal state of the chain. As the fourth connective, it closes the ayah's repeated rhythm: each earlier link accelerated the sequence, and this one delivers the final leveling at the surah's last word.

topics.headline: final connective marks completed result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause is the outcome of punishment, not a new independent action by the offenders.
topics.reason: QAC marks this particle as result or completion, and the clause evidence places it after the divine-action clause.

topics.headline: fourth connective closes the pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated connective pattern reaches its endpoint at the final word of the surah.
topics.reason: This is the fourth connective in the ayah and it introduces the closing verb.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect active making-even or leveling with a feminine object suffix whose antecedent is discourse-inferred and intentionally broad
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes making even, leveling, equalizing, completing, proportioning, and moral badness in related forms; local destruction context selects caused leveling and completion while same-surah proportioning remains an echo
words.prose: {{ar:سَوَّىٰهَا}} ({{tr:sawwāhā}}) seals the ayah with a completed leveling. The Form II verb makes the final state caused and enacted, not merely reached, and the perfect presents the outcome as accomplished. Its feminine suffix is discourse-inferred rather than tied to one overt noun in the ayah; it can gather the punishment event, the settlement or ground, and the scene of ruin without forcing a single narrow object. The root's making-even field turns destructive here: difference collapses into one leveled aftermath. The same surface form appeared in 91:7 for the soul's proportioning, so the final word answers the surah's earlier formation scene with destructive re-formation and closes the surah by joining the four-connective chain to that same-surah echo. Its feminine-suffix cadence also keeps the she-camel narrative and protected watering scene audibly close to the leveled aftermath.

topics.headline: feminine object gathers the ruin scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final suffix keeps the leveled object broad enough to include punishment, settlement, ground, and ruin scene rather than naming only one item.
topics.reason: Attachment support treats the object as discourse-inferred and recommends preserving ambiguity, so rows naming specific referents survive as possible routes rather than exclusive resolutions.

topics.headline: Form II perfect enacts completed leveling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word reports an accomplished caused result: the scene has been made level.
topics.reason: QAC tags the word as Form II perfect with an object suffix, and the lexical evidence supports making even, leveling, equalizing, and completing in this context.

topics.headline: making-even becomes destructive equalization
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root field used for making even or proportioning here becomes the leveling of ruin.
topics.reason: The destruction context selects leveling and equalizing as punitive completion; proportioning and moral-badness branches remain resonance, not replacement.

topics.headline: same form links 91:7 and 91:14
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exact same verb form that described the soul's proportioning in 91:7 now closes the surah with destructive leveling.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the same-surah echo to 91:7, and the local final word shares the same surface form while reversing the contextual payoff.

topics.headline: final word seals chain and surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last word completes both the immediate punishment sequence and the surah-level ring with 91:7.
topics.reason: The final word follows the fourth connective and stands at the surah's end, while same-surah echo rows link it to the earlier proportioning verb in 91:7.

topics.headline: feminine closure keeps the she-camel scene audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final feminine suffix cadence keeps the protected she-camel narrative close to the leveled aftermath.
topics.reason: The cadence and boundary rows connect the feminine suffix pattern around the she-camel and the final leveled result, while attachment evidence still keeps the final referent discourse-inferred.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four fā-linked acts move from declaring false, through disabling the feminine object, to eradication imposed by their Lord because of their offense, and finally to equalization.
baseline_models.mechanism: A public verdict of falsehood licenses an embodied attack; the attack establishes culpability; sovereign eradication answers that culpability; the final act removes distinctions across the affected collective or site. The verse is thus a compressed causal mechanism rather than a list of adjacent events.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes attribution of falsehood and makes the opening verb a public delegitimating judgment that enables what follows.
The branch contributes cutting an animal down by disabling its legs, converting the prior judgment into irreversible bodily action.
Complete eradication supplies the totalizing force of the answering event.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the answering power as one entitled to govern the violated order.
Culpable offense supplies the explicit causal hinge between the communal act and its consequence.
Equality and equivalence make the endpoint a leveling that removes prior differences among the affected.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports denial, killing, punishment, and leveling as four successive facts.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a self-tightening sequence in which a social verdict authorizes violence, violence fixes culpability, and sovereign requital equalizes the whole implicated field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The offense term stands inside the causal chain between total eradication and the final completion, while its branch inventory also carries the image of a tail or trailing end.
baseline_models.mechanism: The community tries to make the warning fail by carrying its assault through, but the deed acquires a trailing consequence. Hamstringing something rare or final without successor is answered by eradication, and the tail of the act reaches a completed endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The branch tests whether a charge proves true by being carried through or false by failing, casting denial as an attempted practical falsification.
The image of a final rare thing with no successor gives the attack a finality extending beyond the immediate wound.
The physical tail or rear end supplies the image of a consequence that remains attached behind the initiating act.
Eradication is the terminal event reached by the deed's attached consequence.
Straightness and completed form close the sequence rather than leaving its consequence unfinished.

changed_reading.before: Their sin is a retrospective moral label explaining an externally added punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their act carries a tail of consequence within it: the attempt to make the warning fail runs through the attack to an eradication that completes the deed's own trajectory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The attack root can cut a source of growth, while both mapped inventories under the Lord root carry nurture, completion, and growing; the final root carries sound formation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The community attacks a life-bearing source and interrupts continuation. The answering Lord is activated not only as sovereign but as cultivator: eradication and leveling become a severe counter-formation of an order whose capacity for growth has been deliberately cut.

activation_trace.role: Cutting a palm's crown or a bird's regrowth source makes the attack an interruption of future growth, not only a present wound.
Repair, nurture, administration, and stagewise completion activate the Lord as the one who forms and maintains an order.
The non-dominant mapped inventory contributes nourishment and growing up, sharpening the contrast between cultivated life and its deliberate cutting.
Complete eradication scales the community's interruption of life up to the social whole.
Sound completion makes the final leveling an imposed re-formation, though the resulting form is destructive for the offenders.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's action is only destructive retaliation for an animal's killing.
changed_reading.after: The response mirrors the deeper structure of the offense: those who cut a source of continuation encounter the cultivator's destructive counter-formation of their own collective order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding reveal-cover alternation turns denial into the maintenance of a false surface. The embodied attack makes that concealed stance visible, while total eradication and the final open-ground image remove both cover and deceptive differentiation.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure and appearance provide the revealing pole of the mechanism.
A cover rising over and concealing something provides the opposed pole of hiddenness.
A patterned surface that deceives by its appearance lets denial operate as a socially maintained false display.
Eradication forcibly ends the concealed arrangement once action has exposed it.
Wide smooth ground supplies the endpoint as a surface on which no deceptive relief remains.

structural_cues: The ordered context places a clause of revealing immediately before a clause of covering, and the focus then compresses four causal transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, cover, deceptive appearance, eradication, and smooth ground; I infer an arrow from concealed denial through exposing violence to stripped surface. A simpler alternation of cosmic visibility without moral transfer remains live.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a spoken refusal followed by an unrelated physical crime.
changed_reading.after: Denial sustains a false covering; the attack discloses what the covering held, and the answering leveling abolishes the deceptive surface itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Building, spreading, individuating a self, and making it sound form an ordered construction sequence. The focus repeats the making-even root after eradication, so its last act reads as deliberate reverse construction: differentiated life and settlement are returned to an imposed even state.

activation_trace.role: Building by joining parts supplies the constructive starting operation.
Spreading and extending supplies the preparation of an inhabitable field.
The very self or identity supplies the individuated object brought into form.
Straightness and sound completion establish making-even as a formative operation earlier in the sequence.
Nurture, administration, and completion identify the actor as one who can form and reform an order.
Eradication supplies the destructive phase separating original formation from reverse formation.
The repeated image of sound, straight completion makes the endpoint purposeful evenness rather than accidental debris.

structural_cues: The same root and verbal pattern used for forming the self recur at the focus ending, after paired sky-building and earth-spreading clauses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a construction sequence and exact root recurrence; I infer a reversal from formation to punitive re-formation. The live alternative is that the final verb merely intensifies total destruction without recalling the earlier forming act.

changed_reading.before: The final leveling is an extra synonym for destruction.
changed_reading.after: The final leveling is the formal inverse of earlier creation: eradication is followed by a deliberate return of the differentiated order to evenness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self is presented as a cultivable, bounded field: rupture can breach it, protection can guard it, a cultivator can split it for growth, or corruption can be inserted and hidden in it. The focus externalizes those alternatives. Denial hides corruption; hamstringing cuts a growth source; eradication and leveling make the inwardly chosen treatment of the self into a communal landscape.

activation_trace.role: A wide breach with bursting emergence supplies the dangerous opening of a moral boundary.
Placing oneself inside protection supplies the counter-operation that preserves the boundary.
The farmer who cleaves earth turns success into skilled opening for cultivation rather than uncontrolled rupture.
Growth and increase supply the result of rightly cultivating the self.
Secret insertion supplies the opposed act of burying or concealing what enters the self.
Corruption and leading astray specify the destructive content of that concealed insertion.
Cutting a source so growth cannot return turns the animal attack into failed cultivation at the social scale.
Culpability binds the external catastrophe to the community's prior treatment of its moral field.
Eradication is the collective-scale manifestation of corruption carried to completion.

structural_cues: The paired success and failure clauses apply opposite treatments to the same feminine self before the narrative applies repeated feminine objects to concrete acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies breach, protection, cultivation, growth, concealment, corruption, and cut regrowth; I infer that the narrative externalizes the self's moral ecology. The alternative is that the ethical pair and historical episode remain illustrative but mechanically separate.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives an isolated historical offense punished from outside.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the communal exterior of the earlier inner mechanism: concealed corruption becomes a cut against life, and the damaged moral field becomes a leveled social field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Collective denial and overflowing excess generate pressure; one especially wretched member is stirred from rest into action, but the focus returns to plural agency. The mechanism distributes responsibility across instigator, executor, and follower-network, explaining why one agent's deed yields equalized collective consequence.

activation_trace.role: Collective attribution of falsehood supplies the shared social verdict preceding the singled-out actor.
Water rising into a sweeping force models collective excess as pressure that exceeds its boundary.
The non-dominant mapped image of a people's raised voice gives that pressure a communal, audible carrier.
Stirring something still from rest supplies the transition from collective condition to an individual's mobilization.
Wretchedness opposed to flourishing marks the selected agent as the concentrated extreme of the group's condition.
The concrete disabling act is grammatically returned to the plural, making execution socially attributable.
Followers imagined as tails expose a hierarchy in which subordinate adherents remain attached to the leading deed.
Equalization supplies the collective endpoint across differentiated roles in the offense.

structural_cues: A collective subject is followed by a singled-out superlative actor, after which the focus again uses plural verbs and plural culpability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective denial, overflow, mobilization, an extreme individual, followers, and final equality; I infer a pressure-to-agent-to-network arrow. A live alternative is that the plural simply credits everyone with the same direct physical act.

changed_reading.before: The plural subject means every member performed an identical act.
changed_reading.after: The focus assigns corporate agency: a collective verdict and excess mobilize one executor, while leaders and followers share the deed's culpable network and therefore its leveled outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger's utterance identifies a divinely protected creature and a defined watering portion. Focus branches for covenant and allotted share then recode denial as repudiation of communicated resource law: disabling the animal extinguishes a claimant and seizes an allocation, so the offenders receive an allotted consequence.

activation_trace.role: A thing's saying as its indication lets the warning make the protected arrangement legible, not merely audible.
Messenger and message supply authorized transmission of the arrangement.
Worship and the worshipped one make the creature and its allocation protected by more than local ownership.
The she-camel in its concrete form fixes the claimant later disabled by the focus verb.
A watering portion and its channel turn the warning into a rule governing access to a shared resource.
Declaring the speaker or report false becomes repudiation of the authorized allocation.
A covenant or pact supplies a binding social form for the communicated protection.
Cutting the animal down is the material means by which its claim on the allocation is cancelled.
An allotted portion, including a portion of punishment, mirrors the seized watering share as the offenders' returned share.
Total eradication gives the returned allotment its collective and terminal scale.

structural_cues: The warning immediately before the focus places the divine name on both the messenger's authority and the animal, then coordinates the animal with its watering claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized speech, divine protection, a concrete animal, a watering share, covenant, and allotted consequence; I infer a law-of-the-commons arrow from warning to breach to returned portion. The alternative remains a general sacred prohibition with no resource-governance emphasis.

changed_reading.before: They disbelieve a messenger and kill a sacred animal, producing generic guilt.
changed_reading.after: They repudiate a publicly communicated covenant over a vulnerable claimant and its water allocation; the physical attack enforces that seizure, and their punishment arrives as the share they assigned themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Early following and late succession bracket the focus. Within that frame, the offense's tail image and the repeated causal conjunctions make each event follow in the track of the prior one; the aftermath is not detachable from the initiating deed but is its rearward continuation and residue.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence establishes an early image of one element tracing the course of another.
A tail or rear end makes culpability the attached trailing part of the act.
Eradication is the event reached when the trailing chain is allowed to run to completion.
Completion and straightness seal the terminal link of the sequence.
Succession and one thing coming behind another extend the following image beyond the focus.
Remainder and trace identify aftermath as what the act leaves behind.

structural_cues: Four fā-marked transitions inside the focus are bracketed by an earlier following clause and an immediately subsequent aftermath clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, tail, succession, residue, and completion; I infer that the conjunctional sequence diagrams consequence as the act's attached track. The alternative is ordinary chronological succession with the offense term retaining only its moral sense.

changed_reading.before: Punishment is a later event externally attached to a completed crime.
changed_reading.after: Crime and aftermath form one tracked motion: the deed grows a tail, each causal clause follows it, and eradication is the trace it finally leaves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following negation joins expected harm and diminution to outcome and aftermath. Read back into the focus, sovereign eradication and equalization admit no counter-cost, retaliation, or surviving claimant capable of reopening the settled event.

activation_trace.role: Fear as expectation of harm supplies the possibility of a future counter-consequence.
Diminution taking from a thing recasts fear as possible loss to the actor, a loss the clause negates.
The last part and outcome identify what might otherwise rebound upon the one acting.
Sovereign authority supplies the actor whose judgment cannot be checked by a rival claimant.
Complete eradication removes the social power from which a retaliatory aftermath could arise.
Equalization closes the field and leaves no privileged remainder from which the action could be contested.

structural_cues: The final negated clause follows the focus without a new named actor and refers back through a feminine aftermath expression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expected harm, diminution, outcome, sovereign authority, and total closure; I infer absence of rebound or counter-claim. Because the unexpressed subject can be read differently, an impersonal statement about the catastrophe's aftermath remains live.

changed_reading.before: The focus ends when the punished group is leveled.
changed_reading.after: The focus's leveling is juridical closure as well as destruction: no rival, cost, or surviving remainder can reverse the sovereign settlement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes punishment through earlier sky and covering images rather than through the eradication root alone. It remains anchored in the focus preposition, totalizing verb, and open-ground branch, but downstream prose should present it as an imagistic overlay, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The eradication is said to come upon them, and the final verb permits an endpoint imagined as a smoothed surface.

activation_trace.role: A covering that encompasses everything supplies the shape of an event enveloping a collective.
What is above and overshadows supplies the vertical orientation activated by the focus's upon-construction.
Total eradication gives the imagined covering destructive completeness.
Wide smooth ground supplies the visual residue after the encompassing force passes.

changed_reading.before: Punishment strikes the group as an abstract destructive decree.
changed_reading.after: A total cover bears down upon the group and resolves into a smoothed plane, making the punishment spatially enveloping as well as terminal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it extends an animal-disabling verb into barrenness, lost succession, and a non-dominant nurture mapping under the Lord root. Those branches, the explicit she-camel, growth context, and complete eradication keep the echo anchored; downstream prose should call it a measure-for-measure generational resonance, not replace the concrete hamstringing sense with infertility.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The attack verb's inventory includes barrenness, severed regrowth, and a last thing without successor; the answering actor's split inventory includes nurture and growth.

activation_trace.role: Barrenness and stopped generation make the wound echo as an assault on continuation.
A final rare thing without successor sharpens the image of a future deliberately cut off.
The non-dominant nurture-and-growth image supplies the answering polarity of cultivated continuation.
Growth and increase establish continuation as a valued process in the preceding moral frame.
The concrete she-camel prevents the generational resonance from floating free of the focus's physical victim.
Eradication mirrors the offenders' local cutting of continuation at the scale of their whole social body.

changed_reading.before: They kill one animal and are then exterminated.
changed_reading.after: Their blow symbolically cuts a protected line of life and succession; collective eradication returns that interruption of futurity upon the society that enacted it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates watercourse and full-bucket branches inside the focus's ordinary culpability term. The explicit watering allocation, overflowing excess, and focus endpoint keep a coherent resource mechanism visible, but downstream prose should retain sin as the governing sense and render the hydraulic material only as latent imagery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causal offense word also carries water-tail and filled-bucket images, and the verse ends with making the affected field even.

activation_trace.role: Overflowing water and sweeping force cast transgression as a resource exceeding its proper boundary.
A defined watering portion and channel provide the concrete hydrological order that is violated.
Watercourse tails and valley ends let consequence run back along the same material network as the violated share.
A large nearly full bucket gives the returned consequence the image of a filled measure.
Smooth open ground supplies the landscape left after the resource violation's consequence has traversed the field.

changed_reading.before: Water belongs only to the prior warning, while the focus concerns an unrelated moral offense.
changed_reading.after: The focus retains a submerged hydraulic logic: boundary-breaking seizure of a water share sends a filled consequence down the social watercourse and leaves the field level.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most branch-distant reading because it uses the non-dominant driving inventory mapped from the watering root and combines it with animal-motion branches in the focus. It remains worth carrying because stopping, disabling, driving, following one track, and eradication form a precise motion mechanism; downstream prose should label it a cross-mapped kinetic echo, never a direct gloss of the watering phrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from a denial branch in which an animal runs and stops to a disabling wound and then immediate eradication.

activation_trace.role: A wild animal running a stage and then stopping supplies the first kinetic interruption.
Disabling the back or movement turns interruption into immobilization.
The non-dominant mapped image of driving and expelling reverses the halted animal's motion onto the offenders as forced movement.
Following in a single track makes that reversal a tightly directed sequence rather than diffuse association.
Complete eradication is the terminus toward which the reversed motion drives the offenders.

changed_reading.before: The animal is stopped and the offenders are separately punished.
changed_reading.after: The motion they stop is kinetically reversed: the perpetrators are driven in one consequence-track toward the terminal eradication they set in motion.

strongest_changes: The repeated making-even root changes the ending from redundant destruction into a deliberate reversal of the earlier forming of sky, earth, and self.
The messenger's warning and the watering portion change denial into breach of an authorized covenant governing a vulnerable claimant and a shared resource.
The shift from collective denial to one mobilized extreme member and back to plural verbs changes agency from a homogeneous mob into a distributed culpability network.
Following, tail, succession, and residue change punishment from an externally appended event into the deed's own attached trajectory.
summary.what_was_special: The focus condensed several domains without forcing them into one verdict: judicial causation, reverse formation, moral cultivation, collective agency, water-allocation law, and consequence as a trailing track. The most productive surprises came from carrying concrete branch images through the repeated roots and pronouns while retaining ordinary senses as coexisting controls.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact referent and scope of the final feminine object remain open, allowing collective, event, victim, and site emphases to compete.
The reverse-formation model depends on treating root and form recurrence as an active structural echo rather than simple repetition.
The covenant-and-allotment reading is mechanically coherent, but the legal arrow from protected share to returned punitive share is reader-supplied.
The nurture, hydraulic, and driven-track outliers use distant or non-dominant branch material and should remain qualified activations rather than replacement glosses.
The unexpressed subject in the final context clause leaves the no-rebound model less secure than the causal and resource-allocation models.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **From declaring false to cutting down: speech becomes bodily disabling.** Lexical evidence: ك ذ ب B002 "declaring false"; ع ق ر B002 "cutting an animal down"; ع ق ر B003 "disabling back or movement"; ن و ق B002 she-camel in 91:13. Structural cue: the fa-sequence connects denial directly to hamstringing. Assigned role: takdhib supplies the verbal refusal; aqar supplies the physical act that makes refusal irreversible. Abductive move: I infer that the body of the she-camel is the site where denial is enacted; the packet supplies the sequence and branches. Reading change: the ayah reads as the materialization of falsehood in a disabled creature.

2. **Punitive leveling as counter-building/repair.** Lexical evidence: د م د م B001 "complete eradication"; ر ب ب B001 "lordship, ownership, and authority"; ر ب ب B002 "repair, nurture, and completion"; س و ي B002 "straightness and sound completion"; س و ي B009 "wide or smooth open ground." Structural cue: the Lord crushes them for their ذنب, then سوىها echoes the earlier soul-fashioning. Assigned role: رب is the authorized owner-repairer; damdama removes the corruption; sawa levels/reorders the violated field. Abductive move: I infer that eradication functions as judicial repair of a damaged order; the packet supplies lordship, repair, eradication, and leveling. Reading change: the punishment reads not as uncontrolled rage but as sovereign re-leveling after a breach.

3. **Sin as tail/trace and allotted share.** Lexical evidence: ذ ن ب B001 "sin and culpable consequence"; ذ ن ب B002 "tail or rear end"; ذ ن ب B006 "portion or allotted share"; ع ق ب B006/B007 end/punitive consequence in 91:15. Structural cue: `بذنبهم` stands between destruction and final lack of fear of aftermath. Assigned role: dhanb carries both offense and trailing consequence/share. Abductive move: I infer that their act drags a tail of liability behind it and receives its allotted return; the packet supplies tail, share, and aftermath branches. Reading change: "for their sin" becomes materially consequential: the deed has a rear-end that catches up.

4. **Aqar as cutting the source of growth and succession.** Lexical evidence: ع ق ر B004 "barrenness and stopped generation"; B007 "cutting the source of growth"; B005 "last rare thing without successor"; ر ح م B003 womb in 91:0; ز ك و B001 growth in 91:9. Structural cue: the protected she-camel stands in a surah that has just described the soul's growth/purification. Assigned role: hamstringing activates sterility and anti-growth, the opposite of زكّى. Abductive move: I infer that the act attacks generativity itself, not only one animal; the packet supplies barrenness, cut growth-source, womb, and growth. Reading change: the ayah reads as an assault on the conditions of mercy, life, and increase.

5. **Cloud/water imagery in the punishment.** Lexical evidence: ر ب ب B008 "low or layered cloud"; ر ب ب B013 "abundant collected water"; س ق ي B007 "rain-heavy cloud" in 91:13; ط غ ي B002 overflowing force in 91:11. Structural cue: the narrative's water-right is violated, then the Lord's response overwhelms. Assigned role: رب branches allow the punitive agency to be imagined through gathered/descending force, while damdama gives totality. Abductive move: I infer a reversal: withheld/violated watering is answered by an overwhelming collected force; the packet supplies watering, cloud, overflow, and eradication branches. Reading change: the punishment can be read through ecological reversal as well as legal retribution.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:15 sharpened ذنب as tail and aftermath: `بذنبهم` is not just a cause phrase but the hinge between act and عُقبى. Looking back to 91:7, the repeated سوى also surprised me: the Lord who proportioned the soul now levels the community, so the same root marks both formative balance and judicial equalization.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Denial completed as bodily disabling.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ك ذ ب/B002` is declaring the messenger or report false and fixed `ع ق ر/B002` is cutting an animal's legs or hocks so it falls. **Structural cue and role:** the two verbs are joined by consecutive *fa-* and preserve different pronominal objects, moving directly from rejecting him to disabling her; denial supplies authorization and hamstringing supplies enactment. **Abductive move:** succession is explicit; the causal claim that epistemic rejection enables bodily violence is inferred. **Reading change:** `فكذبوه` is exposed as an action-program rather than speech that remains verbal.

2. **Severing a source of generation and growth.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ع ق ر/B004` is barrenness or stopped generation and `ع ق ر/B007` is cutting a palm's or bird's source of regrowth; 91:9 `ز ك و/B001` is increase and 91:13 joins she-camel to watering. **Structural cue and role:** hamstringing interrupts an animal-water-yield mechanism, so the cut functions beyond one wound as termination of future increase. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies the generative branches and resource relation; extending the injury to ecological and social futurity is inferred. **Reading change:** `فعقروها` becomes an assault on continuance, not only on one body.

3. **Eradication as removal of counterfeit elevation and restoration of evenness.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `د م د م/B001` is complete eradication; fixed `س و ي/B001` is equalization, `س و ي/B002` straight completion, and `س و ي/B009` smooth open ground. **Structural cue and role:** the high-outcrop branch of `طغوى` and rising-flank branch of `أشقاها` in 91:11-12 culminate in `فسواها`; leveling reverses their claimed prominence. **Abductive move:** eradication and equalizing are explicit, while construing the feminine object without resolving it as people, place, or event and reading the act topographically are inferred. **Reading change:** the close of the ayah is not undifferentiated destruction; it is a leveling of illicit asymmetry.

4. **The nurturer as accountable administrator.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ر ب ب/B001` is ownership and authority, while fixed `ر ب ب/B002` is nurturing, repairing, and administering to completion. **Structural cue and role:** `ربهم` acts after they destroy the protected animal-water order; lordship therefore combines ownership of the violated relation with responsibility for its reckoning. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies ownership, nurture, violation, and response; the arrow from destroyed care to accountable judgment is inferred. **Reading change:** `ربهم` names not a remote title but the administrator whose nurture makes the violation answerable.

5. **Sin as a tail that reaches its aftermath.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ذ ن ب/B001` is culpable offense with bad consequence and `ذ ن ب/B002` is a trailing tail or rear end; 91:15 `ع ق ب/B006` is the outcome brought after an act. **Structural cue and role:** `بذنبهم` sits inside the causal chain and is immediately followed by the surah's explicit aftermath-word, so the tail image makes offense trail into result. **Abductive move:** culpability and aftermath are supplied; turning their adjacency into a continuous causal tail is inferred. **Reading change:** the sin is not a sealed past act but something whose rear trace remains attached until consequence arrives.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 91:15 activates the dormant tail-image of `ذ ن ب/B002` with `ع ق ب/B006`: offense retains a rear trace that arrives as aftermath. It also sharpens `فسواها` as final judgment, because `ع ق ب/B008` allows the next clause to deny any effective follow-up that could review or reverse the leveling.

baseline.text: Onu yalanlayıp deveyi boğazladılar. Bunun üzerine Rableri, günahları yüzünden üzerlerine yıkım indirdi ve onları yerle bir etti.

findings.text: Elçiyi yalanlama, devenin bedenini yere düşürüp hareketini kesen fiziksel bir programa dönüşür; sözdeki ret hayvanın bedeninde uygulanır.
Deveyi kesmek, yalnızca bir bedeni yaralamak değil, çoğalma, yeniden büyüme ve gelecekteki yarar kaynağını ortadan kaldırmaktır.
Rabbin bütünüyle yok edip düzleştirmesi, ihlal edilmiş düzeni sahiplik ve bakım yetkisiyle yeniden kuran yargısal bir onarım olarak belirir.
Günahın kuyruk ve pay boyutları, işlenen fiile bağlı kalan sorumluluğun kendi payına düşen sonucu arkasından sürüklemesini somutlaştırır.
Son düzleştirme, azgınlığın ve en kötü kişinin sahte yüksekliğini ortadan kaldırarak kurulmuş eşitsizliği geçersiz kılar.
Rabbin karşılığı, bulutlarda biriken suyun gökten inmesi gibi, ihlal edilen su hakkına toplanıp inen ezici bir kuvvetle veriliyor olabilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **91:14.** فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا — Birincil okuma: Onlar elçiyi yalanladı, deveyi sakatlayıp öldürdü; Rableri de suçları yüzünden onları bütünüyle ezip düzledi. Sürpriz ikincil okuma, ayetin zincirini sözden bedene, bedenden düzene taşır: yalan, devenin hareketini kesen maddi şiddete dönüşür; ذنب suç olduğu kadar arka iz ve paydır; رب ise yalnız cezalandıran değil, bozulan düzeni yeniden düzleyen sahip ve onarıcıdır. {ك ذ ب B002; ع ق ر B002; ع ق ر B003; ع ق ر B004; ع ق ر B007; د م د م B001; ر ب ب B001; ر ب ب B002; ذ ن ب B001; ذ ن ب B002; ذ ن ب B006; س و ي B002; س و ي B009}

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A field becomes visible, bright, veiled, or perceptually inaccessible through recurring changes of light and covering.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The cycle extends from celestial alternation into polishing, glare, white markings, enveloping calamity, and loss of awareness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Celestial Alternation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Sun, moon, day, and night succeed one another as illumination advances and covering returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: solar disc and light `ش م س:B001/m01`; forenoon interval `ض ح و:B001/m01`; moon and moonlight `ق م ر:B001/m01`; full-moon night `س و ي:B012/m01`; bodily or ranked following `ت ل و:B001/m01`; bright day `ن ه ر:B002/m01`; daylight disclosure `ج ل و:B007/m01`; night darkness `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; covering veil `غ ش و:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lights are not static objects but participants in an ordered relay: one follows, another exposes, and another covers. The lexical senses preserve the same alternation as a movement between visible brightness and enveloping darkness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space becomes habitable or intelligible through construction, leveling, spreading, elevation, and stable support.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmic architecture continues into mountain ridges, smooth plains, house posts, hide shelters, and the base on which property and settlement stand.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cosmic Architecture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An overhead structure and a lower expanse are assembled, spread, and brought into finished form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: building by joined components `ب ن ي:B001/m01`; sky or overhead canopy `س م و:B004/m01`; lower earth opposite the sky `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; spreading and extension `ط ح و:B001/m01`; straightened completed form `س و ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Building, spreading, and leveling form a single spatial operation. The sky supplies the raised canopy, the earth the extended lower field, and leveling the finishing action that gives the whole a coherent constitution.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space becomes habitable or intelligible through construction, leveling, spreading, elevation, and stable support.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Level Expanse and Open Way
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ground is flattened into a broad, fair, traversable interval.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wide smooth ground `س و ي:B009/m01`; fair middle or level place `س و ي:B006/m01`; earth-spreading `ط ح و:B001/m01`; spacious interval and distance `ن ف س:B015/m01`; gap between two sides `ع ق ر:B014/m01`; thick spread carpet `ء ر ض:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Flattening does more than enlarge the ground: it establishes a middle, a gap, and enough interval for passage or settlement. The carpet image miniaturizes the same operation as a portable plane laid out beneath occupants.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Space becomes habitable or intelligible through construction, leveling, spreading, elevation, and stable support.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Elevation is distributed across figure, motion, terrain, and endpoint. The pass and ridge make ascent a bodily route, while the summit, high slab, and raised celestial body make height a stable state of visibility and dominance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: ribs and house posts `ب ن ي:B009/m01`; hide shelter `ب ن ي:B004/m01`; dwelling base or interior site `ع ق ر:B013/m01`; fortified refuge `ع ق ر:B015/m01`; landed property and household goods `ع ق ر:B016/m01`; staying and dwelling `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; earthbound staying `ء ر ض:B006/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: broad opening and water eruption `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; river cutting the earth `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; widened opening `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; irrigation course `س ق ي:B003/m01`; water channels at valley ends `ذ ن ب:B004/m01`; surging overflow `ط غ و:B002/m01` and `ط غ ي:B002/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Flexible material is tensioned or padded to transfer force without breaking the supported body or tool.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bow adhering to its string `ب ن ي:B005/m01`; tendon used as bowstring or binding `ع ق ب:B001/m02`; riding pad `س و ي:B010/m01`; non-wounding saddle `و ق ي:B003/m02`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fruit ripening from its tip `ذ ن ب:B005/m01`; dates spoiled by cold `ق م ر:B004/m01`; yellowing and drying plant `ع ق ب:B015/m01`; cut palm that withers `ع ق ر:B007/m01`; barren sand `ع ق ر:B017/m01`; productive plant growth `ز ك و:B001/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: termite consuming wood `ء ر ض:B010/m01`; moonlight-spoiled waterskin `ق م ر:B006/m01`; milk that disappears instead of continuing `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`; split or cut material `ف ل ح:B001/m01`; remnant after use `ع ق ب:B011/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bodily disturbance becomes visible as tremor, cold, suppuration, fear, internal disease, or unconsciousness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: bodily tremor `ء ر ض:B008/m01`; cold or catarrh `ء ر ض:B009/m01`; suppurating lesion `ء ر ض:B011/m01`; derangement `ء ر ض:B012/m01`; harmful gaze `ن ف س:B003/m01`; visible fear `خ و ف:B005/m01`; cleft lip `ف ل ح:B002/m01`; internal disease `غ ش ي:B003/m01`; habitual intoxicant `ع ق ر:B012/m01`; scorpion sting `ع ق ر:B020/m01`; swoon `غ ش و:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Affliction is legible through altered movement, temperature, tissue, awareness, and expression. The progression moves from external symptom to internal seizure, ending when consciousness itself is covered.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Vital breath and blood sustain life until injury or devouring affliction brings the final gasp.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: breath leaving the body `ن ف س:B001/m01`; life-blood `ن ف س:B004/m01`; living soul `ن ف س:B011/m01`; last gasp `ت ل و:B008/m01`; body-affecting drug or substance `ع ق ر:B008/m01`; consuming fever, calamity, or death `ل ه م:B005/m02`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: aptitude for good `ء ر ض:B003/m01`; suitability and propriety `ز ك و:B004/m01`; deliberation and composure `ر س ل:B004/m01`; meticulous handling `ن و ق:B005/m01`; straight finished form `س و ي:B002/m01`; sustained concern `ق و ل:B015/m01`; respite and room `ن ف س:B015/m01`

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı doğruluğun karşıtı olarak kurar ve bu karşıtlığın hem sözde hem davranışta gerçekleşebildiğini açıkça belirtir. Kişiyi bu nitelikle betimleyen biçimler aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır; birini yalancı sayma eylemi ise ayrı dalın konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçeğe aykırı söz ve davranışı kapsar; başkasını yalancılıkla niteleme eylemini ya da özel kalıpların bağımsız anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın anlam çekirdeğini verir; kişi betimleyen türevler ile özürlere ilişkin kalıp yalnız kendi sözcüksel karşılıklarında gösterilir ve yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün veya davranışın doğruluğa aykırı olmasıdır. Bu niteliği taşıyan kişi, yalan söyleyen ya da yalanı çokça tekrarlayan biri olarak betimlenebilir.

facets.statement: Doğruluğa aykırılık hem söylenen bir sözde hem de yapılan bir davranışta gerçekleşebilir.
Bu niteliği taşıyan veya onu sıkça gösteren kişi, yalan söyleyen kişi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğa aykırılığı ortak çekirdek sayar; kullanım alanını söz ve davranış olarak verir ve bu niteliği taşıyan kişiye yönelik adlandırmaları aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem söz hem davranış alanındaki bütün yalın anlam çekirdeğini karşılayan açıklayıcı üst karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir işlemi değil, birbirine bağlı iki işlemi içerir: bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla nitelemek ve bazı türemiş biçimlerde kişiyi yalancı bulmak ya da yalanını açığa çıkarmak.
